title: Coherent modules on Noetherian schemes are pseudo-coherent
statement: Let $Y$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $\mathcal F$ be a coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Then $\mathcal F$, viewed as a complex concentrated in degree zero, is pseudo-coherent over $\mathcal O_Y$ in the sense of [def-pur-pseudo-coherent-complex].
